# Do not edit — enforced by the guard-paths hook

Lines starting with "- `" are rules; the backticked prefix is matched against the target path.

- `node_modules/`
- `.env`
- `.claude/`
- `.cursor/`
- `.codex/`
- `ai-factory/runs/`
- `ai-factory/.sdlc.json`
{{dont_touch_extra}}

To change adapters, edit ai-factory/ and run /sync. To change a lockfile, run the package manager.
